chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from 'Ala' and Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
An Arab bedouin man should not marry a Muhajirah woman and then take her out of the abode of migration to the bedouins.

key_terms.دَارِ ٱلْهِجْرَةِ: the abode or land of migration
key_terms.ٱلْمُهَاجِرَةَ: a woman identified with migration for faith

ai.seo_question: Can a bedouin Arab man marry a muhajirah woman and relocate her away from the land of hijrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal prohibition concerning marriage to a muhajirah woman when the result would be removing her from the land of hijrah to the land of the bedouins. It reflects the protection of her religious and social status within the community of migration.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4479 - Imam Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"An Arab man should not marry a Muhajira woman (a woman who migrated for the sake of faith) and then take her out of the land of migration to the land of the Arabs."
